ATTN.formula: score_j = v^T tanh(W h_j + b); softmax(score_j + log(content_token_count_j)); weighted sum
ATTN.score_vector_initialization: zeros, so initial pooling equals token-count prior

architectures.MEAN: all chunks; token-count-weighted mean of chunk <s> representations

backbone.tokenizer: original pretrained RoBERTa byte-level BPE; no vocabulary retraining/additions

balance.evaluation: all raw train/validation articles with frozen balance_weight
balance.training: canonical BalancedEpochSampler; article-level balanced sampling; no class/sample weights in loss

fine_tuning.gradient_checkpointing: hardware preflight chooses on/off independently for FT-512 and hierarchical FT
fine_tuning.gradient_diagnostics: record pre-clipping global gradient norm per optimizer step; report mean/median/max and fraction above clipping threshold
fine_tuning.hierarchical_memory_method: preflight selects fastest safe option among direct backprop and exact gradient-cache/replay, each with/without checkpointing where useful; replay is audited against direct gradients
fine_tuning.min_epochs: max(3, full fair-sampler coverage epochs), computed per topic
fine_tuning.mixed_precision: FP16 encoder autocast + GradScaler on CUDA; article pooling/head kept FP32
fine_tuning.optimizer: AdamW; no weight decay on bias/LayerNorm
fine_tuning.scheduler: 10% linear warmup then linear decay toward zero over the 15-epoch maximum schedule

frozen_feature_training.gradient_diagnostics: record pre-clipping global gradient norm per optimizer step; report mean/median/max and fraction above clipping threshold
frozen_feature_training.min_epochs: max(3, full fair-sampler coverage epochs), computed per topic

loss: multiclass cross entropy on article logits; no label smoothing; no class weights

selection.confirmation: mean of each seed run's best validation weighted macro-F1; then mean accuracy; then lower mean CE; predefined order

test_policy: Test metadata counted for integrity only; test text is never loaded/tokenized/embedded/predicted/evaluated.
